terminal_findings.precondition: Same axis and mechanism ID occur with materially distinct behavior.
terminal_findings.event: A later manifestation collides with the existing key.
terminal_findings.observable_failure: The distinct behavior loses separate actionability.
terminal_findings.falsifier: Manifestations remain separately actionable unless current material equivalence is proven.

terminal_findings.event: proven_duplicate is applied without a validated rule and representative corpus.
terminal_findings.observable_failure: Materially distinct manifestations are falsely merged.
terminal_findings.falsifier: A validated corpus demonstrates no false merges, including H0/H1 and current-revision-only proof cases.

terminal_findings.event: The read switch occurs without validating collision handling.
terminal_findings.observable_failure: Projected open counts or audit chronology are incorrect.
terminal_findings.falsifier: Validated replay demonstrates correct aliases, counts, chronology, and rollback.

terminal_findings.precondition: Manifestations merge and the canonical finding is resolved.
terminal_findings.event: Historical projection and resolution scope are reconstructed.
terminal_findings.observable_failure: The governing decision, evidence, coverage, or revision history cannot be reconstructed.
terminal_findings.falsifier: Immutable adjudication and resolution-coverage events plus deterministic boundary replay reconstruct every projection.

limitations: Closed-world run; no external evidence was inspected.
Enable proven-duplicate projection only after the material-equivalence rule and corpus pass validation.
Do not perform the migration read switch until collision replay, counts, aliases, chronology, and rollback are validated.
